notes: Initial N-14 (filed 2021-03-05) of Tidal ETF Trust: proxy statement/prospectus for the reorganisation of American Customer Satisfaction ETF (series of ETF Series Solutions, ticker ACSI, Cboe BZX) into a newly created shell series of the same name in Tidal ETF Trust (adviser change from Exponential ETFs to Toroso). Target and acquirer share the same name and ticker; they are distinguished by trust. Exchange: acquiring shares of value equal to the target's aggregate NAV (nav_for_nav); no fixed ratio, cash or collar. One passage prints the ticker as 'ASCI' ("under the ticker symbol ASCI"); the letter and comparison table print ACSI, which is used. security_class: shares of beneficial interest of an ETF; recorded as common, uncertain. Plan s.3.1 sets Closing at 9:30 a.m. ET on May 24, 2021 'or such other date as the parties may agree in writing'; no outside/termination date (termination by mutual agreement only). registration_effective is from plan s.6.1(d) (the Acquiring Fund's Creation Unit prospectus effective); 'other' covers reps/warranties, covenants and certificates.
